Privacy Policy

Last updated: July 1, 2023

We take your privacy seriously. This policy outlines Famous Birthdays' information gathering, cookie policy, and privacy-related practices. It also discloses our practices and policies concerning privacy laws and regulations such as the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and the EU's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

Processing Your Personal Information

FamousBirthdays.com is an open and easy to use platform. No user login is required nor offered on our website. We don't set any first-party cookies.
